anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI system has generated zero learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it might not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows zero active trades and zero profit/loss, which could indicate inactivity or issues with trade execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI system configurations and logs to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and execution processes to ensure trades are being placed and monitored effectively.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and mitigate any bottlenecks or resource-intensive processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating trading opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Review and potentially restart trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and actively engaging in trades.
